test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following state legislative assembly elections were scheduled in February-March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Elections **for the **403 seats **in the **18th Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly **were held in **Uttar Pradesh **from **10 February to 7 March 2022 over seven stages**.
 
• On March **10, 2022**, the votes **were tallied**, and the **results were announced**.
 
• In the **2021 Uttar Pradesh Panchayat Elections**, **SP won 760 wards**, followed by **BJP with 720 wards**.
 
• **Bahujan Samaj Party won 381 **and **Indian National Congress won 76 wards**.
 
• **Independents **and **smaller parties won in 1,114 wards**.
 
• **AAP won 64 **and **AIMIM won 22 wards in **the panchayat elections.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Legislative Assembly**

 
 
• In India's states and union territories, the legislature is known as the State Legislative Assembly or Vidhan Sabha.
 
• It is the only legislative body in the 28 states and 3 union territories that have a unicameral state legislature, and in 6 states that have bicameral state legislatures, it is the lower house, with the State Legislative Council serving as the upper chamber.
 
• Five union territories have no legislative body and are run directly by the Union Government of India.
